title: DependencyControl Config File v0.6.3 (legacy)
description: The pre-0.7.0 DependencyControl configuration file, whose global settings under `config` use a flat, un-sectioned layout.

macros.description: Installed automation scripts, keyed by their namespaced identifier.

modules.description: Installed modules, keyed by their namespaced identifier.

LegacyGlobalConfig.description: Global DependencyControl settings in the flat, pre-0.7.0 layout. Unknown keys are tolerated, since older releases stored assorted additional flags here. Each key's v0.7.0 destination is noted in its description.

updaterEnabled.description: Master update switch. Migrates to `updates.mode` ('auto-update' when true, 'off' when false).

updateInterval.description: Minimum seconds between automatic update checks for a given script. Migrates to `updates.checkInterval`.

updateWaitTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for another process's in-progress update before giving up. Migrates to `updates.waitTimeout`.

updateOrphanTimeout.description: Seconds after which a held updater lock whose owner vanished is treated as stale. Migrates to `updates.orphanTimeout`.

extraFeeds.description: Your own feeds, searched for updates and crawled for discovery. Migrates to `feeds.extraFeeds`.

traceLevel.description: Default log verbosity; higher levels log more. Migrates to `logging.defaultLevel`.

writeLogs.description: Whether to write logs to file. Migrates to `logging.toFile`.

logMaxFiles.description: Maximum number of log files to retain before the oldest are trimmed. Migrates to `logging.maxFiles`.

logMaxAge.description: Maximum age, in seconds, of a log file before it is trimmed. Migrates to `logging.maxAge`.

logMaxSize.description: Maximum total size, in bytes, of retained log files before trimming. Migrates to `logging.maxSize`.

configDir.description: Directory holding DependencyControl's config files (supports Aegisub path tokens). Migrates to `paths.config`.

logDir.description: Directory holding DependencyControl's log files (supports Aegisub path tokens). Migrates to `paths.log`.

tryAllFeeds.description: Obsolete: enabled an exhaustive update mode that consulted every known feed. Removed in 0.7.0 in favor of trust-ranked source selection.

dumpFeeds.description: Obsolete: a debug toggle that dumped fetched feeds to disk. Removed in 0.7.0, superseded by the on-disk feed cache.

updaterRunning.description: Obsolete transient flag marking an in-progress update. No longer stored in 0.7.0, where concurrent updates are coordinated by a cross-process lock; a leftover value is harmless.

ScriptRecord.description: The persisted installation record for one managed or unmanaged script/module. Beyond the fields below, DependencyControl may store additional bookkeeping here, so unknown keys are tolerated.

namespace.description: The script's namespaced identifier (matches its key in `macros`/`modules`).

version.description: Installed version as DependencyControl's packed version number (a single integer encoding major.minor.patch), not a version string.

feed.description: The feed this script declares for its own updates.

url.description: The script's homepage or project URL.

configFile.description: Name of this script's own per-script config file.

moduleName.description: The Lua module name for a module; `false` for an automation script.

channels.description: Update channels available for this script.

lastChannel.description: The update channel last installed from.

lastUpdateCheck.description: Unix time of the last automatic update check for this script.

unmanaged.description: True for a script present but installed/managed outside DependencyControl (never auto-updated).

ModuleDependency.description: A declared dependency on another module.

moduleName.description: Lua require-path of the dependency — a bare module name ('ffi', 'json', 'Yutils') or a dotted path ('aegisub.util', 'l0.Functional').

version.description: Minimum required version (a semantic version string, or an npm-style range).

url.description: The required module's homepage or project URL.

feed.description: A feed to install the required module from.

name.description: Human-readable name of the required module.

optional.description: When true, DependencyControl skips (rather than fails) if the dependency can't be satisfied.
